value.authenticity_rationale: The pre-image is a declaration-only forward-run compiler-state carrier (MxUnkRecVA 634 prefix, MxUnkRecVB 1 after the includes, PcE 128 at end of file) over the shipped source with the midpoint-distance summands in their original order.  It emits retail's 2338-byte path search exactly, except for four mirrored compares feeding jne, one equality compare whose two frame-slot operands the compiler loaded in the other order, two three-instruction schedule windows, and one 20-instruction region whose independent loads and stores the compiler emitted in a different order; every change is a proved bijection of the same instructions.
